subject: Post-demo qualification: trial rulebook update & owner commitments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@shopwise.com>, Rajesh Menon <rajesh@shopwise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap & trial rulebook proposal

Hi Olivia / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before the trial kick-off: 

Summary of what ShopWise wants to validate during the trial
- Conversational shopping assistant (search-to-cart flow): accuracy of intent routing and response helpfulness
- Cart recovery triggers from abandoned sessions (email/human handoff integration)
- SKU-level product QA: ability to extract attributes from product titles/descriptions at scale

Proposed success criteria (baseline):
- Intent routing accuracy: >= 85% (measured on the provided validation set)
- Generation quality: human-rated helpfulness >= 4/5 on a 200-sample eval
- Latency: 90th percentile token latency < 300ms at expected concurrency (peak ~50 qps)
- Throughput: sustain 50 qps with no more than 10% tail latency spikes during load tests

Evaluation plan / instrumentation
- Redwood will provide an evaluation harness and a small labeled prompt set (we attached an initial rulebook v1).
- Monica (Data Integrations) will own ingestion of ShopWise sample product catalog and session logs.
- Ben (Solutions Engineering) will run the end-to-end evals and produce the quality dashboard.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): data access + test account + SSO
- Week 1: ingest + smoke tests + initial model tuning
- Week 2: scripted evals & human rating batch 1
- Week 3: production-like load test + decision point

Action items (owners)
- Olivia: confirm data access for catalog + sample session logs by Fri 8/6
- Rajesh: procurement contact for contract/PO (cc'd)
- Monica: data ingestion owner (Redwood)
- Ben: eval owner (Redwood)
- Karthik: coordinate weekly checkpoints and commercial follow-ups

Attachments: shopwise_trial_rulebook_v1.pdf (rule definitions), sample_prompts.csv (example prompts)

If this looks good I suggest we treat the rulebook as the single source for pass/fail and add one optional acceptance metric for business impact (conversion lift >= 5% on targeted cohort) as an aspirational goal.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & trial rulebook proposal

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful and comprehensive. A couple of things from our side after internal sync: 

1) New use case ask mid-trial: restock suggestion alerts.
- We run a daily restock job and would like the assistant to suggest optimal restock quantities based on SKU velocity and seasonality signals. This is different from the conversational flow but closely tied to the product metadata extraction we discussed.

2) Data availability: we can provide 30 days of historical velocity and a mapping file, but it will take us an extra week to transform it into the schema you requested.

3) Procurement: we need a short SOW addendum that explicitly calls out data handling + SSO + limited PII policy language for this pilot — Rajesh's team will drive that.

Can you confirm: if we add the restock use case as a scoped optional workstream, does that change the pass/fail criteria materially or just add an additional metric? Also, what is the impact on timeline if we have to wait one extra week for the transformed data?

If possible we'd like to avoid extending beyond 6 weeks total, but we can consider a 1–2 week extension if there's a clear plan and owners.

—Olivia
Head of Product, ShopWise
olivia@shopwise.com | +1 646 555 0123

Hi Olivia / Rajesh —

Thanks for flagging the restock ask — happy to fold it in as an optional "add-on" stream rather than a blocker. Proposed adjustment below so we keep the main conversational evaluation on schedule while accommodating the new metric: 

Proposed re-baseline (short):
- Treat restock suggestion as an optional secondary use case. Pass/fail for the main trial (conversational + cart recovery + SKU extraction) remains as previously defined.
- Add one additional acceptance metric for restock: mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) on suggested restock qty <= 20% on a 500-SKU holdout set provided by ShopWise.

Timeline impact:
- If ShopWise can deliver transformed velocity files by Fri 8/13 we can begin the restock ingest on Mon 8/16 and run an initial scoring sweep by Mon 8/23.
- This plan assumes we keep the core trial window intact and add up to 14 days for the restock eval. Net effect: trial base window unchanged; restock adds an optional 1–2 week extension depending on data readiness.

Ownership (clear owners to avoid scope creep):
- Monica Patel (Redwood): data ingestion + transformation support for restock mapping (SE: Ben to provide transformation examples).
- Ben Carter (Redwood): restock evaluation implementation + metrics dashboard.
- Olivia / ShopWise: provide transformed velocity file + SKU mapping; procurement to sign addendum for data handling.

Next steps / decision points:
1) Olivia: confirm whether you can deliver the transformed velocity mapping by 8/13 (reply here).
2) Rajesh: procurement to review and acknowledge addendum scope; target signature by 8/10.
3) If both confirmed we will:
   - Kick data ingest 8/16;
   - Run scoring sweep 8/23;
   - Present restock results at the weekly checkpoint on 8/24.

I've attached an updated trial rulebook v1.1 that adds the restock metric and a short CSV template for the velocity file.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
